claims: The Golden State Warriors were eliminated in April 2026.
Stephen Curry stated he is "nowhere close" to retiring.
Stephen Curry stated he plans to play for multiple more seasons.
Stephen Curry has not indicated any immediate plans to leave the NBA.
Stephen Curry addressed and dismissed rumors of immediate retirement after the April 2026 season-ending loss.
Stephen Curry clarified he has years left.
Stephen Curry has expressed that he still finds joy, competitiveness, and motivation in playing basketball.
Stephen Curry has expressed that preparation requires more effort now.
Stephen Curry has indicated he is not putting "too much pressure" on a specific retirement date.
